components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact, decisive action used for the next safe operational step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; height:34px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid #96601d; border-radius:5px; padding:0 14px; color:var(--accent-ink, #fffaf0); background:var(--accent, #a86b1f); font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:11px; font-weight:650; line-height:1; transition:transform 120ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color:#845116; background:#935b18; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #9a611d); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained bordered action that stays subordinate to the primary path.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; height:34px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid #d0c8bb; border-radius:5px; padding:0 14px; color:#504b43; background:#f9f7f1; font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:11px; font-weight:650; line-height:1; transition:transform 120ms ease-out, color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#aea292; color:#292621; background:#fffdf9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #9a611d); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A warm evidence field with a restrained amber focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; width:280px; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; color:#625c53; font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:12px; } .ds-field input { width:100%; height:38px; border:1px solid #d2cabd; border-radius:5px; padding:0 12px; outline:none; color:#302d28; background:var(--surface, #fbfaf6); font:inherit; transition:border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#8e8579; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#b8ad9d; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#b2772d; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(178,119,45,.12); }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.description: A compact pill for a selected filter or evidence scope.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display:inline-flex; height:34px; align-items:center; border:1px solid #c99d60; border-radius:999px; padding:0 11px; color:#70440f; background:#f2e7d6; font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.01em; transition:transform 120ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { border-color:#b48445; color:#523107; background:#efe0c9; } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #9a611d); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-filter-chip:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: A flat, border-led container for evidence, metrics, and operational context.
components.html:
Evidence source

Latest accepted posture

Server summaries from locally retained reports.
components.css: .ds-panel { width:320px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #d8d1c5; border-radius:7px; color:var(--text, #292722); background:var(--surface, #fbfaf6); font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-panel header { border-bottom:1px solid #e0d9ce; padding:11px 14px; } .ds-panel small { color:#716b61; font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-panel h3 { margin:3px 0 0; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; padding:14px; color:#716b61; font-size:11px; line-height:1.6; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color:#bdae99; } .ds-panel:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #9a611d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current console destination inside the graphite operational shell.
components.css: .ds-nav-shell { width:220px; padding:10px; background:#292923; font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-active { display:flex; height:38px; align-items:center; border-radius:5px; padding:0 12px; color:#fffaf0; background:#3b3932; box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 #d69a43; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-active:hover { color:#ffffff; background:#454239; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d69a43; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav-active:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Online Status Pill
components.description: A text-first status label for healthy or connected system state.
components.css: .ds-status-online { display:inline-flex; width:fit-content; align-items:center; border:1px solid #b8c5ba; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 8px; color:#4f6f5c; background:#edf1eb; font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em; transition:border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-status-online:hover { border-color:#91aa97; background:#e7eee7; } .ds-status-online:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #9a611d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Critical Severity Badge
components.description: A squared, explicit critical-severity label for findings and exposures.
components.css: .ds-severity-critical { display:inline-flex; width:fit-content; align-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(183,79,82,.34); border-radius:4px; padding:3px 6px; color:#9d3f43; background:rgba(183,79,82,.08); font-family:var(--font-main, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.01em; transition:border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-severity-critical:hover { border-color:rgba(183,79,82,.55); background:rgba(183,79,82,.12); } .ds-severity-critical:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #9a611d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: The compact graphite instrument mark with three amber evidence bars.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { display:grid; width:32px; height:32px; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); align-items:end; gap:3px; border:1px solid #5a5145; border-radius:5px; padding:6px; background:#35332d; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08); transition:border-color 140ms ease, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-brand-mark i { display:block; border-radius:1px 1px 0 0; background:#d49a45; } .ds-brand-mark i:nth-child(1) { height:45%; opacity:.55; } .ds-brand-mark i:nth-child(2) { height:90%; } .ds-brand-mark i:nth-child(3) { height:65%; opacity:.72; } .ds-brand-mark:hover { border-color:#766d5e; } .ds-brand-mark:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #9a611d); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-brand-mark:active { transform:scale(.97); }

narrative.overview:
Linux Security Auditor should feel like a calibrated instrument: precise, warm, calm, sharp, premium, and trustworthy. The graphite operational shell establishes orientation and restraint; the warm cream workspace and evidence surfaces keep dense analysis legible without becoming clinical.

The system favors compact enterprise analyst density and decisive hierarchy. Operators authenticate with minimal friction, enter a dense console, scan security state, and act without losing source evidence or host context. It explicitly rejects hacker or neon aesthetics, decorative gradients, black cards, oversized controls, ornamental color, and soft consumer-SaaS styling.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces inside a graphite operational shell.
Structural borders and tonal layering instead of decorative shadow.
Amber reserved for action and current state.
Calm semantic color for assurance, incidents, severity, and evidence status.

rules.name: The Amber Discipline Rule
rules.body: Amber communicates action or current state; its rarity is part of the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Metadata Contrast Rule
rules.body: Operational metadata must maintain a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 on every warm surface.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Geist everywhere; code-like and numeric content gains tabular alignment rather than a separate monospace personality.

rules.name: The Context-Preservation Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts may stack or progressively disclose, but must not separate an action from the evidence, host, or security state needed to judge it.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Borders and tonal layers carry structure; ambient shadow is reserved for login and temporary overlays.

rules.name: The Radius Ladder Rule
rules.body: Use the 5px / 7px / 10px ladder for controls, panels, and overlays; do not introduce large soft consumer radii.

dos: Do use amber only for primary action, current state, or a narrow evidence emphasis.
Do preserve compact 34px controls and the 5px / 7px / 10px radius ladder.
Do use borders, section rules, and tonal layers to make dense evidence scannable.
Do keep metadata contrast at or above 4.5:1 and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do keep actions beside the host, evidence, and security state required to judge them.
donts: Don't use hacker styling, neon color, or decorative gradients.
Don't introduce black content cards, ornamental color, or shadow-heavy card stacks.
Don't enlarge routine controls or soften the interface into consumer-SaaS styling.
Don't use amber as ambient decoration or semantic status when a specific severity color exists.
Don't hide safety boundaries, evidence lineage, or stale-state consequences behind visual polish.
